Word Solitaire Pro

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 28 October 2026

Word Solitaire Pro is a free card puzzle game by Waghade Studio. It has no accounts and no sign-in, and it never asks who you are. Your progress and your settings are kept on your own phone and are not sent to us or to anyone else. The one thing that leaves your device is what Google’s advertising service collects in order to show ads, and where the law requires it you are asked about that on Google’s consent form first.

What the game stores on your phone

  • The stars and your best move count for each level you have finished, which levels are unlocked, and the level you played last.
  • How many hints you have left.
  • The day of your last daily spin and how many extra spins you have taken that day.
  • Your sound volume and your vibration setting, and whether you have seen the how-to-play screen.
  • Whether you have tapped “Rate this game”, and when the game last asked for a rating, so that it does not ask too often.

All of this is kept in the app’s own private storage on your device. It is not uploaded, not shared, and never seen by us. Uninstalling the game deletes it. You can also clear your stars and unlocked levels at any time from Settings → Reset progress inside the game.

Advertising

Word Solitaire Pro is free and is paid for by ads served by Google AdMob. There are three kinds, and this is all of them:

Banner
A strip along the bottom edge of the screen. It never covers the game.
Full screen
After every second level you finish, on the tap that takes you to the next level or plays it again. Never in the middle of a level, never when the app opens, and never within a minute of another full-screen ad.
Rewarded video
Only if you choose to tap “Watch ad”: for two more hints when you have run out, or for an extra daily spin. It says what it gives you before you tap it, it never plays on its own, and the reward is only paid once you have watched it to the end.

To show those ads, Google may collect and process information such as your device’s advertising identifier and other device identifiers, device and app information, your IP address (which gives an approximate location), how you interact with the game and with ads (such as app launches, taps and video views), and diagnostic information such as performance data. Google uses this to serve and measure ads, and to detect fraud.

We do not receive any of that information ourselves, and we do not sell personal information. The game has no analytics of its own and no crash reporting service.

Your choices about ads

  • If you are in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom or Switzerland, Google’s consent form is shown the first time the game runs. You can change or withdraw your choice at any time from Settings → Ad privacy choices inside the game.
  • You can reset or delete your advertising ID from your phone’s own settings, usually under Settings → Google → Ads.
  • You never have to watch a rewarded video. Every level can be finished without a hint, and the daily free spin needs no ad.

Ratings and reviews

After an especially good finish the game may ask Google Play to show its own rating sheet. That sheet belongs to Google: we are never told whether you rated the game or what you wrote. “Rate this game” in Settings opens the game’s page in the Play Store.

Security and how long data is kept

  • Your progress, your hints and your settings are kept in the app’s own private storage on your phone, which other apps cannot read. They stay there until you clear them from Settings → Reset progress or uninstall the game.
  • We run no servers and keep no data about you, so there is nothing of yours for us to store, secure or delete.
  • The information Google collects for advertising is sent from your phone to Google over an encrypted connection (TLS). Google keeps and deletes it under its own privacy policy, at policies.google.com/privacy.

Permissions

The game itself asks for nothing. Every permission it declares comes from the Google Mobile Ads library it uses:

INTERNET, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
Fetching ads.
AD_ID
The advertising identifier described above.
ACCESS_ADSERVICES_*
Android’s Privacy Sandbox, declared by the ads library.
FOREGROUND_SERVICE, WAKE_LOCK
Declared by a library the ads SDK depends on. The game does not use them.

What the game does not do

  • It does not ask for an account, an email address or any personal details.
  • It does not use your camera, microphone, contacts, photos or location.
  • It has no chat, no user-generated content and no social features.
  • The cards and the levels are built into the app, so the game plays with no connection at all. Only the ads need one.

Children

Word Solitaire Pro is not directed to children under 13, and is not part of Google Play’s Designed for Families programme. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided information through this app, please contact us at the address below and we will help.

Changes to this policy

If this policy changes, the new version ships with the next update of the game and is published on the same page the Play listing points at. The date at the top tells you which version you are reading.

Contact

Questions about this policy can be sent to support.waghadestudio@gmail.com.
